# Corcoran Communications

> Veteran-owned, AI-powered marketing agency in Quakertown, Pennsylvania.
> AI-built websites, automated SEO/AEO monitoring, lead generation,
> Google Ads, social media marketing, and content marketing for
> businesses in Bucks and Montgomery Counties and the Greater Lehigh
> Valley.
> Call or text 215-259-8304. Email greg@corcoranpr.com.

Corcoran Communications is led by owner Greg Quinn, a U.S. Navy veteran
(USS Chancellorsville) and Temple University graduate, supported by AI
agents that monitor client websites, search rankings, and Google
algorithm changes around the clock. The firm was founded by Ruth Corcoran
(now retired) and carries over half a century of Corcoran family work in
marketing, design, and print. Past and present client work includes
Disney on Ice, Ringling Bros. Circus, Pittsburgh Craft Beer Week, SenArt
Films, Spirit Financial, Tri County Collision, and ILM.

## Services

- AI-Built Websites: fast, modern, schema-structured sites with no platform fees
- Automated SEO/AEO Monitoring: AI agents scan site health weekly and watch Google/AI-search changes daily, with plain-English reports clients can read
- Lead Generation: landing pages, offers, follow-up, and tracking measured in calls and booked jobs
- Google Ads: search and local campaigns, tightly managed
- Social Media Marketing: Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok content and campaigns
- Content Marketing: blogs, email, and web copy structured to be quoted by AI search

## Location and service area

- Address: 1808 Enclave Dr, Quakertown, PA 18951
- Primary service area: Bucks County, Montgomery County, and the Greater Lehigh Valley (Lehigh and Northampton Counties), PA (Quakertown, Doylestown, Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton)
- Also serves longtime clients across Pennsylvania, New York, and New Jersey

- [Social Media Marketing](https://corcoranpr.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok content and campaigns
- [Lead Generation](https://corcoranpr.com/services/lead-generation/): landing pages, offers, follow-up, and tracking measured in calls and booked jobs
- [Trade School Marketing](https://corcoranpr.com/industries/training-centers/): enrollment marketing for training centers and trade schools, measured in enrollments rather than clicks
- [Credit Union Marketing](https://corcoranpr.com/industries/credit-unions/): marketing for credit unions and community financial institutions, measured in applications and new accounts
- [Auto and Collision Shop Marketing](https://corcoranpr.com/industries/auto-collision/): marketing for auto repair and collision shops, built around local map presence, reviews, and calls
- [Law Firm Marketing](https://corcoranpr.com/industries/law-firms/): marketing for law firms and attorneys, built inside attorney advertising rules and measured in consultations and retained clients
- [Restaurant and Event Marketing](https://corcoranpr.com/industries/restaurants-hospitality/): marketing for restaurants, bars, events, and hospitality, measured in covers, reservations, and ticket sales
- [Film and Live Entertainment PR](https://corcoranpr.com/industries/film-live-entertainment/): public relations and local-market promotion for touring shows, independent film, and live events
- [Bucks County](https://corcoranpr.com/locations/bucks-county/): marketing, web design, and SEO for businesses across Bucks County, Pennsylvania

## Practical answers

- To start: call or text 215-259-8304, or email greg@corcoranpr.com for a free AI-powered website audit.
- Accounts are led personally by the owner. No junior account teams.
- AEO (answer engine optimization) is a core service: getting businesses named in AI assistants' answers, not just ranked in search results.
